title: NODE — The Seed on the Plain

features.name: a thing, cream along the top and green underneath
features.desc-on-touch: For several kilometres he called it a silo. Swollen at one end, drawn out at the other into a blunt projection with a row of openings. The handle is filled with sky and large enough to hoop a truck. She says it is a seed.

features.name: the plaque
features.desc-on-touch: A president, a secretary, a treasurer and the members of a committee. Beneath these, the businesses that contributed materials. The concrete has the small exposed stones of old public swimming pools.

features.name: a photograph, improved
features.desc-on-touch: Composed beside the truck, at midday, with direction from both parties.

inscription: the thing remains visible for a long time, then the road turns

file.name: Photo_Seed_Midday.jpg
file.note: A woman appears to be giving birth to a large concrete seed. The photographer was told to move.

reverie.title: REVERIE — a roadside, midday
narr: She wanted a photograph in which she appeared to be giving birth to it.
You crouched beside the truck and directed her.
She laughed and told you to move yourself instead,
Back on the road she rested one foot on your knee
and took a grass seed out of her sock.

exits.label: the road on
exits.to: NEW: the stubble of one harvested paddock after another, and the concrete seed still visible behind you
